description: Source code for a workflow testing module in an Odoo (OpenERP) environment, including class and method definitions for analyzing workflows, views, and related objects.

classes.name: quality_test
classes.description: A class that performs workflow-related quality checks within an Odoo module, including validation of workflow structure, views, and activity nodes.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the quality_test class with specific parameters such as name, note, minimum score, and installation requirement.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Executes the workflow validation test, analyzing views, fields, workflows, and activities, and computes a score based on workflow integrity and view analysis.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Generates a formatted table summarizing the test results.

methods.name: get_result_details
methods.description: Creates an HTML detailed report of the workflow analysis results.

methods.name: count_button
methods.description: Recursively counts the number of 'button' elements in an XML node tree.
